tools.name: get_auth_status
tools.description: Status of the Cinex, Cines Unidos and Supercines sessions and the next connection step. The Supercines account is optional: without it, prices are the public ones. Returns no personal data or secrets. configured does not guarantee that the provider has not revoked the session.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Lists providers and implemented coverage. This capability catalog does not perform a live availability check.

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: In hosted mode, starts Cinve authorization automatically when needed. If the account is already connected, returns connected=true: repeat the original query without asking the user for anything. Otherwise, returns connected=false and a private, single-use link for the user to connect their Cinex, Ci

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.description: Disconnects the user's cinema account in Cinve and cancels pending links. Does not revoke the session directly on the cinema's website. Use when the user asks to disconnect.

tools.name: get_seats
tools.description: Actual seat map without booking: Cinex and Cines Unidos require cinema_id, session_id and a connected account; Cinepic also requires movie_id, without login. Use IDs from get_showtimes. Returns counters and the full ASCII map, where each seat appears with its label and state (O = status available);

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Lists the provider's cities. Use their names when querying Cines Unidos.

tools.name: list_cinemas
tools.description: Lists venues and IDs. Cines Unidos requires city; Supercines accepts an optional city; Cinepic verifies its configured venues Candelaria and VVIP Lido. tools.description: Searches movies by name. Cinepic requires cinema_id (123300 Candelaria or 123301 VVIP Lido) and filters the day's showtimes; Cines Unidos requires city and allows cinema_id/date. tools.name: get_showtimes
tools.description: Gets showtimes for a date (today in Caracas by default). tools.description: Gets ticket prices (Gran Cine does not publish them). Cinepic requires cinema_id, movie_id and session_id from get_showtimes. tools.name: get_concessions
tools.description: Gets concessions by venue. Cinepic and Cines Unidos require only cinema_id, via a public API; Cinepic may return an empty catalog. Cinex requires cinema_id and a connected account. Supercines requires only cinema_id. Stock only when verified; does not use zero for missing prices.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: connect_account, get_showtimes, get_ticket_prices · Private data: get_auth_status, connect_account · Public sink: connect_account, get_ticket_prices · Destructive: get_showtimes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: connect_account, get_showtimes, get_ticket_prices · Private data: get_auth_status, connect_account · Public sink: connect_account, get_ticket_prices · Destructive: get_showtimes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
